links.comparator_used: Baseline GPT-4 Turbo without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and clarity on open-ended HCV questions; correct DAA regimen selection in 25 simulated scenarios
links.effect: RAG-Top10 vs baseline: accuracy 91.7% vs 36.6% (p<0.001); clarity 91.7% vs 46.6% (p<0.001). RAG-Top1: 81.7% accuracy, 86.6% clarity (both p<0.001). Correct DAA regimen in 76% of cases with RAG-Top10 vs 24% for baseline (p<0.001).
links.quote: On open-ended questions, RAG-Top10 outperformed baseline in accuracy (91.7% vs. 36.6%; p < 0.001) and clarity (91.7% vs. 46.6%; p < 0.001).

links.comparator_used: Baseline GPT-4 Turbo used off-the-shelf without fine-tuning
links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and clarity on open-ended HCV questions
links.effect: SFT reached 71.7% accuracy and 88.3% clarity (p<0.001) vs baseline 36.6% accuracy and 46.6% clarity.
links.quote: RAG-Top1 achieved 81.7% accuracy and 86.6% clarity (both p < 0.001), while SFT reached 71.7% accuracy and 88.3% clarity (p < 0.001).

links.comparator_used: RAG retrieving only the top 1 passage vs top 10 passages, with the same guideline embeddings
links.outcome: Accuracy and clarity of answers, and DAA regimen selection, with different numbers of retrieved passages
links.effect: RAG-Top10 accuracy 91.7% and clarity 91.7% vs RAG-Top1 81.7% accuracy and 86.6% clarity; RAG-Top10 gave the highest correct DAA regimen performance (76%). The Top1 vs Top10 difference was not reported with a separate test.
links.quote: RAG-Top10's broader context retrieval confers the greatest gains, while SFT underscores the value of domain-specific alignment.
